title.tr: Beyaz boyalı ve doğal lambri numune panosu
title.en: Sample board of white-painted and natural tongue-and-groove boards

alt.tr: Yan yana dizilmiş, beyaz boyalı ve doğal tonlu lambri tahtalarından oluşan numune panosu
alt.en: Sample board of tongue-and-groove boards set side by side, white-painted and natural in tone

caption.tr: Dört tahta beyaza boyanmış, sağdaki tahta boyasız doğal tonda. Numune küçük bir ahşap ayak üstünde duruyor.
caption.en: Four boards are painted white and the board on the right is unpainted in its natural tone. The sample stands on a small timber foot.
